brief:
Israeli settlers carried out a series of coordinated assaults across the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem on Monday, IMEMC News reported. The attacks involved invasions of Palestinian communities, arson targeting residential homes and agricultural land, physical assaults on Palestinian residents, destruction of crops, and sieges of homes.

The incidents marked an escalation in settler violence across the occupied territories. Residents reported that attackers set fires to buildings and fields while preventing Palestinians from accessing their properties. The nature and scope of casualties or infrastructure damage remained unclear as reports continued to emerge from affected communities.
